messages:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — HelixWorks just signaled an expansion. Three new squads want access: Edge Insights, Retail Ops, and Data Platform. Expecting real-time summarization and per-customer KV caching. Early numbers look like QPS could go from ~20 -> ~70 across their org in next 8 weeks. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Liam (SolutionsEng): Nice. Do we know which model families they're planning to use? That affects latency and batching strategy.
Priya (CSM): They're evaluating a mix: an open LLaMA-derived for embeddings + a ~30B decoder for summarization. Asking for <150ms p50 target for short prompts (~128 tokens).
Maya (Customer Success): I'll start an enablement playbook for Edge Insights. We should capture example prompts and a short runbook for best-effort prefix caching.
Ethan (AE): +1. Also flagging renewal — they renew in 4 months. This expansion looks like an upsell opportunity but also a risk if perf isn't hit. Let's get a capacity proposal and cost estimate by EoW.
Nora (Onboarding Eng): If they need it, we can provision a dedicated low-latency pool (T4x2 / A10x1 configs) and prewarm KV caches. I can draft sizing. Quick question: do we have expected concurrency per squad?
Priya (CSM): Rough breakdown from their engineering lead: Edge Insights 25 qps, Retail Ops 15 qps, Data Platform 10 qps — spikes possible during ingest windows. So peak ~70 qps, sustained ~35 qps.
Liam (SolutionsEng): OK — plan: route Edge Insights to low-latency pool with aggressive batching disabled and prefix caching enabled. For summarization use dynamic KV cache and 4-token lookahead. Example policy snippet they asked for:
```
route_policy:
  - name: helixworks-edge
    model_family: decoder-30b
    preference: low_latency
    batching: disabled
    caching: prefix_kv_enabled
    autoscale_min: 2
    autoscale_max: 10
```
Nora (Onboarding Eng): That helps. I'll submit a Dedicated pilot request with that config. Need approval from infra for prewarmed nodes.
Maya (Customer Success): I'll collect 6–8 canonical prompts and latency SLIs from them for our eval harness. Also scheduling a 1-hr workshop next Tue to walk through best practices.
Ethan (AE): Can we prepare a 1-pager for the Exec renewal conversation showing projected cost vs performance uplift? Priya, can you capture revenue lift estimate?
Priya (CSM): On it. Tentative numbers: if they fully onboard, MRR could +$18k. I'll confirm after workshop.
alerts-bot: Ticket created: CS-2897 — "HelixWorks Dedicated Pilot / Edge Insights" assigned to Nora.
Liam (SolutionsEng): Action items: (1) Nora to request dedicated pilot + infra signoff (CS-2897) — due Thu EOD. (2) Maya to run workshop & collect prompts — schedule for Tue. (3) Priya to finalize renewal upsell sketch and customer ROI — draft by Fri. (4) Ethan to prep exec 1-pager once numbers are in.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll loop in infra and legal for the data handling notes (they asked about per-customer isolation). Will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
